## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive (Energy, Technology). Confirmation: very narrow sector participation despite large-cap tech strength (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA ABOVE TREND) and widespread 1W/1M divergences (multiple CORRECTION/RECOVERY names), supporting a neutral, wait-for-confirmation stance.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Energy leads: MPC (1W: +7.92% | 1M: +25.09%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +7.24% | 1M: +15.90%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +5.58% | 1M: +10.20%) ABOVE TREND. Technology shows concentrated leaders: CRM (1W: +25.48% | 1M: +38.81%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +12.52% | 1M: +25.14%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials have pockets of strength: DE (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +11.74%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Consumer Discretionary weak: RCL (1W: -9.10% | 1M: -17.99%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -8.46% | 1M: +1.55%) CORRECTION. Materials mixed with exhaustion: FCX (1W: -9.31% | 1M: +13.87%) CORRECTION, NEM (1W: -9.26% | 1M: +28.58%) CORRECTION. Financials soft: PYPL (1W: -15.85% | 1M: -9.45%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: CRM (1W: +25.48% | 1M: +38.81%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +12.52% | 1M: +25.14%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +7.92% | 1M: +25.09%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +7.24% | 1M: +15.90%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +11.74%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (3 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: TTWO (1W: -6.98% | 1M: -11.61%) BELOW TREND, MNST (1W: -7.67% | 1M: -6.64%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -7.77% | 1M: -1.50%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -7.96% | 1M: -14.64%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -8.46% | 1M: +1.55%) CORRECTION — weakness concentrated in select tech and consumer names.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Best 1W momentum: CRM (1W: +25.48% | 1M: +38.81%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +12.52% | 1M: +25.14%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +7.92% | 1M: +25.09%) ABOVE TREND; downside momentum notable in PYPL (1W: -15.85% | 1M: -9.45%) BELOW TREND and SHOP (1W: -9.14% | 1M: +19.49%) CORRECTION — major short-term divergence present.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Tech shows mixed leadership with concentrated winners and several laggards: AAPL (1W: +4.91% | 1M: +7.25%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +1.89% | 1M: +2.94%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +2.06% | 1M: +5.23%) ABOVE TREND, but GOOGL (1W: -3.44% | 1M: -10.30%) BELOW TREND and AMAT (1W: -7.96% | 1M: -14.64%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Technology included in the 2/11 positive sectors but leadership is narrow; watch for follow-through.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Financials generally soft: JPM (1W: -0.49% | 1M: +0.66%) CORRECTION, V (1W: -2.99% | 1M: +2.10%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -3.05% | 1M: +1.77%) CORRECTION, PYPL (1W: -15.85% | 1M: -9.45%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: -2.36% with broad internal weakness; style call not confirmed by breadth.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Healthcare shows idiosyncratic moves and mixed sentiment: JNJ (1W: -0.71% | 1M: +7.12%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: -0.07% | 1M: -4.59%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -5.97% | 1M: +3.59%) CORRECTION. News catalysts (MRK, SYK, AMGN) exist but sector 1W: -1.62% — watch for stock-specific follow-through rather than broad sector leadership.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor selective exposure to Energy and standout Tech leaders (CRM, NOW, MPC, CVX) while reducing exposure to the weakest Consumer Discretionary and isolated Financial losers (PYPL, RCL). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow breadth and major divergences; remain selective and monitor trend confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: CRM (1W: +25.48% | 1M: +38.81%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +7.92% | 1M: +25.09%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +5.58% | 1M: +10.20%) ABOVE TREND — watch momentum continuation. BEARISH: PYPL (1W: -15.85% | 1M: -9.45%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -7.96% | 1M: -14.64%) BELOW TREND, RCL (1W: -9.10% | 1M: -17.99%) BELOW TREND — monitor for further downside.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +5.04% | 1M: +13.22%) — concentrated above-trend names driving performance. BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary (1W: -3.66% | 1M: -4.87%) and Financials (1W: -2.36% | 1M: -1.29%) — watch for spillover if breadth fails to improve.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
CRM (1W: +25.48% | 1M: +38.81%) ABOVE TREND — sustain weekly momentum to confirm broader tech leadership. AAPL (1W: +4.91% | 1M: +7.25%) ABOVE TREND — holds as a large-cap internal ballast for tech. NVDA (1W: +2.06% | 1M: +5.23%) ABOVE TREND — watch for any 1W weakness that would signal narrowing leadership. CVX (1W: +5.58% | 1M: +10.20%) ABOVE TREND — Energy leadership confirmed while breadth is thin.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
CRM (1W: +25.48% | 1M: +38.81%) (+60): Salesforce AI ARR surge — price and trend confirming (ABOVE TREND). SYK (+80) and MRK (+65) flagged by headlines for positive approvals/trials but stock-level 1W/1M trend data not in the top detailed view here — monitor for confirmation.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
BA (1W: -2.57% | 1M: -11.92%) (-50): Boeing headlines on quality/production concerns — price BELOW TREND confirming negative sentiment. JNJ (1W: -0.71% | 1M: +7.12%) (-45): legal/talc headlines with price in CORRECTION (1W down, 1M up) — divergence to monitor. GOOGL (1W: -3.44% | 1M: -10.30%) (-40): negative talent-drain headlines and price BELOW TREND — sentiment and performance aligned.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. CRM, MPC, CVX showing relative strength (CRM ABOVE TREND; MPC ABOVE TREND; CVX ABOVE TREND). Key risk: major 1W/1M divergences (multiple CORRECTION/RECOVERY cases) and thin sector breadth (2/11) — monitor for trend confirmation before broad exposure adjustments.
